metric.why: Some operators and older DCIM dashboards report DCiE rather than PUE. Knowing both prevents misreading a 77 percent DCiE as something other than a 1.3 PUE.
metric.target: A 1.3 PUE and a 77 percent DCiE are the same facility.
metric.formula: (IT equipment energy / total facility energy) x 100
metric.definition: The same measurement as PUE expressed the other way round, IT energy as a percentage of total facility energy.
